page.overview:
What is Nobody I Know?

Nobody I Know is a song written by Paul McCartney (credited to Lennon/McCartney) and recorded by Peter and Gordon in an April 1964 session at Abbey Road Studios. It was supposed to be a follow-up to the duo's hit single A World Without Love, but remained unreleased.
